general.cpm_high: High CPM usually means audience competition is intense or your audience size is too narrow (< 100k). Try broadening your targeting.
general.ctr_low: Low CTR indicates the visual hook isn't stopping the scroll. Test high-contrast imagery, user-generated videos, or a bold problem statement in the first 3 seconds.
general.cpl_high: High CPL can happen if your lead form has too many complex questions or your offer isn't compelling enough.
general.zero_conversions: Zero conversions with normal clicks is almost always a Pixel/CAPI tracking misconfiguration or a slow/broken landing page.

sim-rookie-01-salon-leads: Set your objective to 'Leads' so Meta optimizes for bookings rather than cheap clicks.
Choose a balanced local audience (100k-2M) and test a before/after video creative with a special introductory discount.
sim-rookie-02-fix-narrow-audience: A narrow audience under 50,000 causes frequency and CPM to shoot through the roof. Expand your age range or remove restrictive interest layering.
sim-operator-01-budget-split: Allocate 70% of budget to cold prospecting (TOFU) and 30% to retargeting website and social engagers.
sim-operator-02-creative-ab-test: In a clean A/B test, keep audience and budget identical and change only the video hook.
sim-operator-03-tracking-fix: Always verify that standard events (Lead, Purchase) fire with correct currency and value parameters in Events Manager.
sim-strategist-01-scale-budget: Scale vertically in 15-20% increments every 48-72 hours to prevent resetting Meta's machine learning phase.
sim-strategist-02-account-audit: Look for audience overlap, learning limited ad sets, fragmented budgets, and missing exclusions.

boss-rookie-launch-day: For a local business wanting bookings, 'Leads' objective beats 'Traffic' every single time.
On day 3, don't panic if spend is still optimizing. Check CTR first to ensure people find the creative attractive.
If frequency is under 1.5 and CTR is above 1.5%, give the ad set time to exit the learning phase.
boss-operator-expensive-leads: When CPL jumps overnight, don't change your winning ad copy immediately! Check your tracking pixel and landing page load speed first.
Excluding people who already converted in the last 30 days immediately lowers wasted spend.
boss-strategist-scale-or-kill: Campaigns with ROAS consistently above 3.0x and stable CPM are prime candidates for vertical budget increases.
If a campaign has frequency > 5.0 and falling CTR, killing or refreshing creatives is better than pouring more money into it.
